name: IGB Fellows Symposium 2027
organizer: Carl R. Woese Institute for Genomic Biology, University of Illinois Urbana-Champaign
venue: 612 Conference Center, Institute for Genomic Biology
description: The IGB Fellows Symposium is an annual event hosted by the Carl R. Woese Institute for Genomic Biology bringing together campus researchers for keynote talks and a poster session with travel voucher awards. The 2027 edition had not been scheduled as of September 2026; the 2026 edition was held in early May.

sources.note: 2026 IGB Fellows Symposium held May 7, 2026 at the 612 Conference Center, IGB, with keynote talks and a poster session offering three $500 travel vouchers

notes: This symposium spans genomic biology broadly rather than clinical medicine specifically; included because it is a UIUC research symposium with a competitive poster session relevant to biomedical trainees. The 2027 date was not yet published as of September 2026.
